title: OutRun 2006: Coast 2 Coast
description: Sumo Digital's OutRun2 port for the original Xbox — the game our Xbox oracle drives from cold boot into the race. The Studio carries the /Cars roster — the player's Dino 246 GTS, the fifteen AI rivals and the twelve-vehicle traffic fleet — and the first course off the disc: the beach island from /Stage, decoded from the same _pmt mesh format the cars taught us to read.
